'''Bersin Sekolah''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who served as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] in for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Republic Scout Service/Legends|Scout Service]]. Sekolah left the Service after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], convinced that the Scout Service would become a tool of military oppression and expansion. Sekolah chose to retire to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]], a world he once visited during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="J15" />

Sekolah turned his attention to finding ways to restore life to Tasariq, and spent over twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] studying the ecology of the planet. Much of his work involved trying to create [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life that could convert the [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[Gas/Legends|gases]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] to produce [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]].<ref name="J15" />

During his stay on Tasariq, Sekolah was rewarded with a [[topaz crystal]], granting him the power of [[Life Detection]], and a [[turquoise crystal]] which gave him the ability of [[natural navigation]].<ref name="J15" />
